stat_columns.is: MAX HP -- entity+0x34 is set from it in the next instruction
physical attack MAX; slot 2 rolls min + rand(max - min) from this pair on attack kind 0
reaches the defender block as def+0x04, buff channel 1 -- a defence term, not otherwise traced
non-physical attack MAX; the same roll on any other attack kind
ACCURACY -- slot 2 writes it to atk+0xcc, scaled 4/10 into the to-hit chance
EVASION -- slot 3 writes it to def+0x40 after rec+0x04 and the buff, scaled 0x333/0x1000 into the chance. NOT a percentage: it spans 1..700
EFFECT RESISTANCE -- slot 3 writes it to def+0x4c, one of three terms subtracted from 100
UNREAD. Reaches the attack packet as atk+0xdc on attack kind 0; the largest hard-mode multiplier in the vector at 300%
UNREAD. Rises steeply with tier, which is EXP-shaped, but no reader has been traced
UNREAD and 0 in all 201 shipped rows; the only column no scaler touches
UNREAD. The only WORD, and it ships exactly {0x1000, 0x10CD, 0x119A} -- 1.00, 1.05, 1.10 in 1.19.12, with bosses pinned at 1.00 on every tier

stat_scaling: the copied row is multiplied twice by percentages out of 100, grouped by scale_index: once by a ten-ushort record FUN_020320c8 picks (party size or the quest record -- the table itself is NOT located), and once by the literal vector {0:250, 1:120, 2:140, 3:150, 4:100, 5:130, 6:300, 8:250, 9:110} under a flag bit. So a live entity is this row times those, not this row.
